description: Git-backed text storage; messaging via file conventions. Every folder has an AGENTS.md (instructions for agents) and a .metatrash.json (settings); read the space root AGENTS.md first.

mcp.tools: tools/list exposes tools only; tools/call uses the shared service.
mcp.accountTools: The OAuth endpoint adds the spaces, pull, pending and push tools. Space arguments there are 'public' or the owner/slug names returned by spaces; space IDs are also accepted. Results name owned spaces by owner/slug. The anonymous /mcp endpoint accepts configured space names only.

authentication.private: Space-scoped bearer key: read permits read/search/list/history; write permits all. Transport credentials only.
authentication.rateControls: Shared limits across clients/transports; admin overrides per space.
authentication.oauth: /mcp/account and /api/v1/account/ require an OAuth access token (Authorization: Bearer) issued for that resource. Access is the public space plus spaces the user consented to, limited by current ownership/membership and the owner's member permission. Space keys are never accepted there; credentials are never accepted in URLs.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read text at HEAD or revision; returns snapshot state. Start with path AGENTS.md: instructions for agents in this space; each folder has its own. A .metatrash.json that inherits also returns effective: its settings with the parent folder's filled in. For a long file, read only the lines you need with startLine and lineCount (search gives line numbers); lines then reports the range and the file's total lines.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

startLine.description: First line to return (1-based). With startLine or lineCount, text holds only those lines, each with its line ending.

lineCount.description: How many lines to return from startLine (default: to the end).

deletable.description: False for a folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json (protected); delete and move refuse them.

readOnly.description: Set when a readOnly entry in the folder's .metatrash.json locks the file: "agents" (agents cannot write, edit, move, rename or delete it; refused with read_only_file) or "everyone" (nobody can until a person lifts the lock).

effective.description: Present when the file is a .metatrash.json that inherits: the folder's settings with the inherited ones filled in.

lines.description: Present when startLine or lineCount was given.

end.description: Last line returned; start-1 when none.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find lines in a space's files, like grep: returns each matching line with its path, file ID and line number, and optionally lines of context. Use it to locate text before an edit, or to choose which lines to read, instead of reading whole files. Plain text by default; regex uses RE2 syntax. Results are in path and line order, up to limit.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

query.description: Text (or regular expression) to find within one line.

prefix.description: Folder prefix ending in /; empty selects all.

regex.description: Treat query as an RE2 regular expression.

context.description: Lines of context before and after each match.

text.description: The matching line without its line ending, cut to 400 bytes.

truncated.description: More lines matched than limit; narrow the query or prefix.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create a file or replace its whole text. To change part of an existing file, use edit instead: it sends only the changed text. Every folder has an AGENTS.md (what the folder holds and how to work in it; rewrite it freely) and a .metatrash.json (its settings), added with the folder's first file and removed with its last other file; neither can be deleted or moved. A .metatrash.json is checked on write: a JSON object with optional inherit (true: take every setting but services from the parent folder, own keys override; new folders start with it), locked ({"key": "agents" or "everyone"}: keys of this file, purpose, children, services, inherit, readOnly or locked, that agents ("agents") or nobody ("everyone") may add, change or remove; refused with locked_setting; locked itself only a person changes), readOnly ({"spec.md": "agents", "*.pdf": "everyone", "archive/": "agents"}: files of this folder, by name, pattern or subfolder/, that may not be written, edited, moved, renamed, deleted or created; refused with read_only_file; not inherited; an ordinary key unless locked), purpose (text), children ({"name" or "folder/": text}) and services ([{"type":"github","repo":"owner/name","branch":"main","push":"agent"}]); unknown keys are refused. Services: own spaces only, not at the root, no github folder inside or around another. Files under a github folder belong to that repo; files outside it are space-only. Names starting with a dot (.gitignore, .github/workflows/ci.yml) are allowed only inside a github folder; .git is never allowed. Editing a github folder: pull first (at the start of each session), edit with write, move and delete, call pending to see what will be sent, then push with a message; nothing reaches GitHub until push (push "agent", the default). If push reports GitHub moved ahead, pull (it keeps your changes when no file changed on both sides), then push again. Results in a github folder carry a hint once changes have waited unpushed for 30 minutes.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

text.description: UTF-8; no NUL; byte limits apply.

ifInState.description: State from read, list or search. Refused with state_mismatch only if a file this change touches changed since (or anything, with strict); on state_mismatch, re-read before retrying.

strict.description: Refuse when anything in the space changed since ifInState, not only the files this change touches. Use it when this change depends on other files you read.

deletable.description: False for a folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json (protected); delete and move refuse them.

readOnly.description: Set when a readOnly entry in the folder's .metatrash.json locks the file: "agents" (agents cannot write, edit, move, rename or delete it; refused with read_only_file) or "everyone" (nobody can until a person lifts the lock).

hint.description: Present when this change lies in a GitHub folder whose oldest unpushed change is over 30 minutes old (at most once per 30 minutes per folder): check pending and push when the work is ready.

rebased.description: Present (true) when ifInState was older than the space's state: the change was applied on top of newer changes to other files.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Change part of an existing file without sending its whole text: each edit replaces oldText, which must match the current text exactly once (include enough surrounding text to make it unique, or set replaceAll), with newText. Edits apply in order; all or none are saved, as one change in the file's history. No ifInState is needed: an oldText that no longer matches is refused with conflict, so read or search again and retry. Pass ifInState to also refuse when this file changed since that state (other files may have changed). Files written with CRLF line endings match LF oldText. Same rules as write otherwise: .metatrash.json is validated and its locked keys enforced, files marked readOnly are refused (read_only_file), the file limit applies. To create a file or replace all of it, use write.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

oldText.description: Exact current text to replace, including spaces and line breaks.

replaceAll.description: Replace every match instead of requiring exactly one.

ifInState.description: Optional state from read, list or search: refuse with state_mismatch if this file changed since then (or anything, with strict).

strict.description: Refuse when anything in the space changed since ifInState, not only the files this change touches. Use it when this change depends on other files you read.

deletable.description: False for a folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json (protected); delete and move refuse them.

readOnly.description: Set when a readOnly entry in the folder's .metatrash.json locks the file: "agents" (agents cannot write, edit, move, rename or delete it; refused with read_only_file) or "everyone" (nobody can until a person lifts the lock).

hint.description: Present when this change lies in a GitHub folder whose oldest unpushed change is over 30 minutes old (at most once per 30 minutes per folder): check pending and push when the work is ready.

rebased.description: Present (true) when ifInState was older than the space's state: the change was applied on top of newer changes to other files.

tools.description: List files and snapshot state; folders are implicit. A folder may describe itself in its .metatrash.json; list when a folder has none.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

prefix.description: Folder prefix ending in /; empty selects all.

cursor.description: Previous nextCursor; keep other arguments unchanged.

deletable.description: False for a folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json (protected); delete and move refuse them.

readOnly.description: Set when a readOnly entry in the folder's .metatrash.json locks the file: "agents" (agents cannot write, edit, move, rename or delete it; refused with read_only_file) or "everyone" (nobody can until a person lifts the lock).

tools.name: move
tools.description: Atomic same-space file move; preserves ID/text. Destination must be absent. No directory moves. AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json files never move. Files marked readOnly cannot move, and nothing moves to a locked name (read_only_file).

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete a file. Earlier revisions stay readable with read and a revision. A folder's AGENTS.md and .metatrash.json cannot be deleted; they go with the folder's last other file. Rewrite .metatrash.json to remove settings. Files marked readOnly cannot be deleted (read_only_file).

tools.name: history
tools.description: File history across moves and deletes, newest first, each change with who made it (by). Read old content using entry path+revision; for a delete entry, use the next older entry. Deleted files keep their history.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

cursor.description: Previous nextCursor; keep other arguments unchanged.

by.description: Who made the change: name (the account's username, or its email address before the @), app (the app it was made through: Metatrash Sync for a person, the connected app such as Claude for an agent, or space key) and kind (person or agent). Absent on changes before 0.47.0 and on the service's own.

write.note: REST write, move and delete default to strict: true (the whole-space check sync clients rely on); send strict: false for the per-file check MCP uses by default. Edit defaults to the per-file check everywhere.

spaces.note: OAuth only. Operation routes are also available as /api/v1/account/spaces/{space}/... where {space} is public, an ID, or {owner}/{slug}.

errorNotes: state_mismatch includes currentState; rate_limited/queue_full include retryAfterSeconds (REST: Retry-After). MCP errors: isError=true + text JSON; success: structuredContent per outputSchema. conflict comes from edit (an oldText that no longer matches once) and from pull and push; github_unavailable from pull and push.

accountTools.name: spaces
accountTools.description: List the spaces this connection can use and its access to each. Pass a returned space value (owner/slug) to the other tools.

space.description: Value for the space argument: owner/slug, or public.

id.description: Immutable space ID, also accepted as the space argument; absent for the public space.

owner.description: Owner's public username; empty for the public space.

accountTools.name: pull
accountTools.description: Fill or update a GitHub folder from its repository (the github service in the folder's .metatrash.json: repo and branch, default main) and record the commit it came from (the baseline for pending and push). Call it at the start of each session. The first pull needs the folder empty apart from .metatrash.json files, or holding identical copies; it refuses and names any other files. Later pulls bring the folder to the branch's latest commit (creating, updating and deleting files). Files changed here since the last pull or push stay as they are and stay pending, as long as GitHub did not change the same files; a file changed on both sides stops the pull (conflict, naming the files; no line merging). UTF-16 and UTF-32 files with a byte order mark are converted to UTF-8 with a UTF-8 byte order mark and listed under converted; GitHub keeps the original until the file is edited and pushed. Files Metatrash cannot hold (binary, other encodings such as Latin-1, over the file limit, names outside the path rules, symbolic links, submodules, .metatrash.json) are skipped and listed; they stay on GitHub untouched. Needs write access. Errors: conflict (see message), forbidden (no GitHub connection or the app cannot reach the repo), storage_limit, github_unavailable.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

folder.description: The GitHub folder, for example site/ (the folder holding the .metatrash.json with the github service).

commit.description: Repository commit the folder now matches.

newState.description: Space state after the pull; equals oldState when upToDate.

upToDate.description: True when the folder already had the branch's latest commit; nothing was written (local changes stay pending).

skipped.description: Repository files not held in the folder (first 50), by path in the repository.

converted.description: Files held as UTF-8 (with a UTF-8 byte order mark) that are UTF-16 or UTF-32 on GitHub (first 50), by path in the space.

localChanges.description: Files changed here since the last pull or push that the pull left in place; they stay pending for push.

accountTools.name: pending
accountTools.description: List what push would send from a GitHub folder: files added, modified and deleted since the last pull or push (each with baseState, the space revision holding the previous version: read the path with that revision to compare). Also lists files .gitignore excludes (notPushed; .gitignore applies only to files the repository does not hold, as in git), changes push refuses (refused: files in .github/workflows/), and unchanged files pull converted to UTF-8 (converted: GitHub keeps its UTF-16/UTF-32 copy unless the file is edited; some Windows files need UTF-16, such as PowerShell 5.1 scripts with non-ASCII text and .reg files). upToDate means nothing to push; oldestChange says when the oldest pending change was written. Pass state as ifInState to push to send exactly what you checked. Read access is enough. Errors: conflict (not pulled yet).

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

folder.description: The GitHub folder, for example site/ (the folder holding the .metatrash.json with the github service).

baseCommit.description: GitHub commit of the last pull or push.

baseState.description: Space revision holding the files of baseCommit (empty if unknown).

state.description: Current space state; pass it to push as ifInState.

oldestChange.description: When the oldest pending change was written, if it can be told.

baseState.description: Space revision holding the previous version; read the path at it to compare. Absent for added files and for files pull skipped.

accountTools.name: push
accountTools.description: Send a GitHub folder's pending changes to GitHub as one commit on its branch, with your message; check pending first. All or nothing: it refuses (and sends nothing) when the folder has not been pulled, when GitHub moved ahead of the last pull or push (pull, then push again), when a change touches .github/workflows/, or when the folder's push mode is "review". Never forces. GitHub records the commit as the Metatrash app and signs it (Verified); the message names you in a Co-authored-by trailer (your GitHub account if you linked one under Connect GitHub, else your Metatrash username) and adds Metatrash-Space and Metatrash-Agent trailers. Files pull skipped stay on GitHub untouched; files .gitignore excludes are not sent. Nothing pending: upToDate, no commit. Changes written while a push runs stay pending. Needs write access. Limits: 1000 files, 40 MB, 10 pushes per space per 10 minutes. Errors: invalid_request, conflict (see message), state_mismatch (folder changed since ifInState), forbidden, payload_too_large, rate_limited, github_unavailable.

space.description: Space name. On /mcp/account: owner/slug from spaces, public, or a space ID.

folder.description: The GitHub folder, for example site/ (the folder holding the .metatrash.json with the github service).

message.description: Commit message: a short first line, then details if useful. At most 4000 characters.

ifInState.description: Optional state from pending (or read/list): push refuses if any file in the folder changed since then. Writes elsewhere in the space do not count.

upToDate.description: Nothing was pending; no commit was made.

parent.description: The commit of the last pull or push, which the new commit follows.

baseState.description: Space revision holding the previous version; read the path at it to compare. Absent for added files and for files pull skipped.

state.description: Space state whose files were pushed.

newState.description: Space state after recording the push.
